name: hud_county
vintage: HUD FY2026 Income Limits; FY2027 Fair Market Rents
source: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, HUD USER API
attribution: This product uses the HUD User Data API but is not endorsed or certified by HUD User.
notes: Limits apply to HUD areas; a county inherits its area's limits (see hud_area_name).
hud_median_family_income is HUD's area median family income (AMI), not ACS median household income.
fmr_small_area = True: HUD sets ZIP-level Small Area FMRs there; the area-wide ('MSA level') FMR is used.
